verdict.rationale: The pack never documents adding Gmail, IMAP or other third-party accounts to Outlook, or working several accounts from a unified inbox. The first-party evidence covers the Microsoft Graph mail API for a single Microsoft 365/Exchange mailbox. The only community mention (a user with "multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts" complaining about slow Windows clients) does not establish that Outlook itself connects those Gmail accounts.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
